EmployeeCompetence.title: Employee competence
EmployeeCompetence.description: One qualification one employee holds, from a date and optionally until one: a BOA bevoegdheid, a heftruckcertificaat, a BHV diploma. A competence whose validUntil has passed stops counting on its own date, without anybody editing the record, because that is the day the roster has to refuse the shift (agenda-rostering-and-resource-booking, REQ-ROST-C01).

competenceCode.title: Competence
competenceCode.description: The code of the qualification, for example boa-domein-1.
competenceCode.x-notes: Matched against Shift.requiredCompetences by CompetenceCheckService. A free code rather than an enum: a gemeente's list of qualifications is not a thing humaniq can enumerate in advance.

label.title: Label
label.description: What this qualification is called, for a reader.

issuedOn.title: Issued on
issuedOn.description: The first day this qualification counts.

validUntil.title: Valid until
validUntil.description: The last day this qualification counts. Leave empty when it does not expire.

note.title: Note
note.description: Anything the planner should know about this qualification.

Resource.title: Resource
Resource.description: Something that can be booked for a period: a room, a vehicle or a piece of equipment. A resource carries a quantity, because one room is not one geluidsmeter: three inspectors and two meters means the third waits (agenda-rostering-and-resource-booking, REQ-AGD-003).

name.title: Name
name.description: What this resource is called, for example Hoorzittingzaal 2.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: What sort of thing this is.

orgUnitId.title: Org unit
orgUnitId.description: Which team this resource belongs to. Leave empty to make it bookable everywhere.

quantity.title: Quantity
quantity.description: How many of this resource there are. A booking past this number over one period is refused.
quantity.x-notes: REQ-AGD-004: the overlap refusal fires when the overlapping bookings would EXCEED this number, so a room is quantity 1 and two meters is quantity 2.

location.title: Location
location.description: Where this resource is, for a reader who has to go there.

active.title: Active
active.description: Whether this resource can currently be booked. A resource out of service refuses a booking.

ResourceBooking.title: Resource booking
ResourceBooking.description: One resource held for one period, by one employee, optionally for a named object in another app. A booking that would take a resource past its quantity over an overlapping period is refused on the write rather than reported in a later run: a room booked twice for one hoorzitting is a person standing in a corridor (agenda-rostering-and-resource-booking, design D6).

employeeId.title: Booked by
employeeId.description: Who booked it, and whose agenda it stands on.

purpose.title: Purpose
purpose.description: What it is booked for, in a few words.

domainObjectType.title: Object type
domainObjectType.description: Which kind of object this booking belongs to, as app:schema.
domainObjectType.x-notes: The hours-leaf shape, verbatim: the `<app>:<schema>` literal, for example dossiq:zaak. Written the same way in both places on purpose, so a consuming app addresses hours and bookings identically.

domainObjectRef.title: Object
domainObjectRef.description: The uuid of the object this booking belongs to.
domainObjectRef.x-notes: The hours-leaf shape: the object's uuid, in the app named by domainObjectType. A free string rather than a $ref, because the object lives in another app's register.

CalendarSubscription.title: Calendar subscription
CalendarSubscription.description: An iCalendar feed humaniq reads for one employee, to know when they are busy. humaniq never writes to it and never makes an object from an event in it: an employee's private agenda is not humaniq's to edit, and a two way sync makes a deletion ambiguous in a way nobody can debug (agenda-rostering-and-resource-booking, design D7).

feedUrl.title: Feed address
feedUrl.x-notes: Read only. Nothing humaniq does issues anything other than a GET against this address (REQ-AGD-005).

label.title: Label
label.description: What this calendar is called, for the person who administers it.

active.title: Active
active.description: Whether humaniq still reads this calendar.

lastPolledAt.title: Last read
lastPolledAt.description: When humaniq last read this calendar.

lastPollStatus.title: Last result
lastPollStatus.x-notes: REQ-AGD-005: a failed poll records the degradation here and LEAVES THE CACHE alone, so a feed that is briefly down does not empty somebody's agenda.

busyPeriods.title: Busy periods
busyPeriods.description: The periods this calendar says the person is busy.
busyPeriods.x-notes: Cached busy time ONLY: each item is {start, end}. No title, no location, no attendees, no organiser, ever. The AVG boundary leave-calendar-nc draws for the Nextcloud calendar, drawn again here.
